title: Completed WBS DICTIONARY Data Contract
description: Additive structural schema validating completed WBS DICTIONARY artifact data payloads (PMO-04.02.07).

wbs_identifier_and_title.description: The unique WBS code number and descriptive name of the specific work package.

control_account_and_responsible_organiza.description: Associated control account code and organizational unit or person accountable for delivery.

work_package_owner.description: Designated lead engineer or manager responsible for work package execution.

work_package_scope_description.description: Detailed narrative describing the technical work, tasks, and activities required for this package.

deliverables_produced.description: Specific tangible or intangible outputs generated upon work package completion.

milestone_schedule_and_target_dates.description: Target start date, intermediate technical milestones, and completion deadline.

quality_requirements_and_standards.description: Mandatory quality metrics, engineering specifications, and technical standards.

acceptance_criteria_and_sign_off_lead.description: Clear criteria and designated stakeholder authorized to accept the work package.

required_resources_and_skills.description: Personnel roles, technical expertise, materials, and specialized equipment needed.

cost_estimate_and_budget_allocation.description: Approved budget allocation and cost baseline figure assigned to this work package.

assumptions_constraints_and_dependencies.description: Specific operational constraints, key assumptions, and preceding/succeeding work package linkages.
